title: Touch-control press feedback and the cooldown-ended flash
oneLine: data-pressed written outside React on every control, plus a per-button {was, at} edge detector for the ready flash.
topConcern: RideButton, the one control drawn on computers, has no onMouseLeave: a press released elsewhere leaves it pressed and its mouse latch armed.

title: Whirlwind and Shield Bash buttons
oneLine: Hidden, cooling, cannot-cast or ready: a 200 ms view of abilityStatus, re-read on every shield edge.

title: Block button: down, UP, cooling
oneLine: The Block button draws the phone's _shieldUp and a 2 s stamina cooldown face.
topConcern: The worker's 3 s guard break never reaches the phone, so the button stays lit UP; its cooldown face's one writer is switched off.

title: Jump button and the html[data-jump-clear] prompt switch
oneLine: Ground/air/hidden on an 80 ms key poll, a 700 ms ghost-mouse window, and a page attribute set per commit.
topConcern: Cleanup removes data-jump-clear but leaves three custom properties on <html>; harmless, every reader is scoped under the attribute.

title: Sprint button tap detector
oneLine: Turns a real tap (14 px, 600 ms) into toggleSprint and shows off/on/running/tired from S._sprint.
topConcern: A second finger on the button overwrites the pending touch so neither lift toggles; rare, harmless.

title: Special button: normal, cooling, no mana, queued AIM
oneLine: Special's cooldown (_lastSwipe), mana and the bow's queued request (_bowSpecialQueued) drawn as one button face.
topConcern: A bow special pressed while cooling queues and lights AIM; when the line lands the cooldown refuses silently, losing the special and that arrow.

title: TRAP button: ready, setting, armed, grey
oneLine: A keyed 120 ms view of S._trap pending/mark; arm asks the worker, which decides and refreshes one mark.
topConcern: Dead branch: the grey 'No box traps' row can never show because the view returns null first.

title: Skateboard button: off, asking, on, hidden
oneLine: Ride toggle button over S._ride, hidden whenever a fight is near or you leave the safe ground.
topConcern: Riding with a monster locked (or shield-live) hides the button while rideCheck keeps you on the board: a rider loses the only touch off-switch.

title: Quick-eat button
oneLine: Shown with food and missing HP; a press posts the key to eatBus; the one-bite wait drawn as an arc.

title: Weapon pill: in hand, tap to swap, refusal shake, html[data-wpill-shown]
oneLine: A keyed view of R.activeSlot and owned slots, a tap detector calling BroTown's one cycler, and a page attribute.
topConcern: Five copies of the touch-echo window (800 ms here, 700 elsewhere); every pill tap also latches _userCycledSlot for the session.

title: Keyboard controls shown or hidden
oneLine: bt_kb_hints_off: one writer (BroTown), three readers (React state, DeskKeysList, deskKeysW) of localStorage.
topConcern: With storage refused the state flips but the desk-wide column and world width read storage, so the column never folds.

title: The two discs' DOM under BroTown's per-frame stamps
oneLine: Render-only: initial opacity/pointerEvents/data-show that BroTown's resolver overwrites every frame.

title: Legacy toolbar: one window at a time and the old logout
oneLine: display:none toolbar toggling the show* window flags and an old multi-RPC logout chain.
topConcern: Its dead logout removes bt_passphrase, today's Login Key, the opposite of the live logout that keeps it.

title: Legacy modals: old Inventory, Skills, Stats, Info, Encyclopedia
oneLine: Open/close flags reachable only by QA's _uiPanels, with local eat/equip/sell, stat locks and the Bro verify row.
topConcern: InfoPanel is the only caller of verifyBro and nothing opens it, so the Hemi Bro wallet check is unreachable for players.

title: Furniture Workshop: crafting paid on the phone alone
oneLine: Live farm-house window that takes coins and wood, grants XP and records furniture only in S.rpg and bt_rpg.
topConcern: Craft sends nothing: client-only economy; v2 deltas never correct the lowered coins until the worker's coins change; _furniture lives on one device.

title: Old Pet House window (deploy-order fallback)
oneLine: Active pet toggled locally in lifeSkills.pets; opens only when caps.petbook is not advertised.
topConcern: If shown, the active pet is a phone-only choice kept in bt_rpg, the reason its own header retired Evolve and Enchant.

title: Ace's coin flip dialog
oneLine: Open, staking, pending with a 6 s silent-refusal timeout, settled, closed; results carry no request id.
topConcern: A reply slower than 6 s reads as a refusal and frees a second stake; a result after closing returns as next visit's stale verdict.

title: Emote picker and its pointerdown dismiss layer
oneLine: Closed/open on Moves or Emoji (remembered in bt_emote_tab), closed by a pointerdown anywhere on a world-wide layer.
topConcern: Closing on pointerdown lets the tap's click land on what lay underneath: a weapon-pill well swaps, TRAP arms, the canvas locks a monster.

title: Login door: checking, buttons, picker, device-full card
oneLine: Logged-out page: checking, the two doors, the character list, and the full-device card.
topConcern: The full-device card's scrim closes on pointerdown, so its tap can fall through onto Continue or Create beneath.

title: NEW MONSTER card
oneLine: One {kind, at} codex announcement shown 3 s, its clock pushed forward while a loading screen is up.
topConcern: A UI poll mutates the announcement's clock; held forever only if the loading screen itself never clears.

title: A new pet's card
oneLine: S._trap.card raised when the snap animation ends; a draft name kept per card; Done or a sent name closes it.

title: Fish weigh-in card
oneLine: Weighing, answered, closed after 9 s, ✕ or Records; module-level card re-armed per answer.
topConcern: A late fish_weight reopens a card the player had already closed, since the answer ignores st.pending.
